mail/imap_command#

IMAP commands as values: a closed set, built from typed arguments and never from raw text.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

ImapCommand(simple: ImapSimpleCommand.noop);
ImapCommand(operation: ImapMailboxCommand.select, mailbox: ImapMailboxName("INBOX"));
ImapCommand(uids: set, data: [ImapDatum.flags, ImapDatum.headers]);              // UID FETCH
ImapCommand(uids: set, flags: MailFlags(SystemFlag(SystemMailFlag.seen)), change: FlagChange.add);   // UID STORE
ImapCommand(uids: set, destination: ImapMailboxName("Archive"), move: true);    // UID MOVE

Description#

IMAP commands as values: a closed set, built from typed arguments and never from raw text.

Every message operation goes by UID. APPEND sends the message as one synchronizing literal after the server's continuation. ImapSession builds and sends these for you.

object ImapCommand#

object ImapCommand

Closed command representations. Constructor calls use named arguments when arities overlap. No constructor accepts raw command/criteria text. APPEND uses one synchronizing literal; caller must await continuation before sending literal_bytes(). UID operations never fall back to sequence numbers.
